title: Multi-omics profiling reveals intrathymic triggers and novel biomarkers in thymoma-associated myasthenia gravis
data_availability_statement: The raw sequencing data generated in this study will be deposited in the China National Center for Bioinformation (CNCB) Nucleotide Sequence Archive ( https://ngdc.cncb.ac.cn/ ) , or in an alternative repository specified by the journal upon manuscript acceptance. All processed data supporting the findings of this study are included in this published article and its supplementary information files. Any additional datasets not directly related to the presented results are available from the corresponding author, Dr. Ding, upon reasonable request.

evidence.quote: To bolster the robustness of our findings, we integrated our in-house scRNA-seq profiles from five AChR⁺ MG-positive and five MG-negative thymomas with four external datasets: ( https://singlecell.broadinstitute.org/single_cell/study/SCP1532 , 4 MG + thymomas and PBMCs from 2 of these 4 patients) [ 24 ], and ( https://ngdc.cncb.ac.cn/gsa-human/browse/HRA002334 , 1 MG + and 4 MG − thymomas) [ 32 ].
evidence.context: To bolster the robustness of our findings, we integrated our in-house scRNA-seq profiles from five AChR⁺ MG-positive and five MG-negative thymomas with four external datasets: ( https://singlecell.broadinstitute.org/single_cell/study/SCP1532 , 4 MG + thymomas and PBMCs from 2 of these 4 patients) [ 24 ], and ( https://ngdc.cncb.ac.cn/gsa-human/browse/HRA002334 , 1 MG + and 4 MG − thymomas) [ 32 ]. Healthy thymus sequencing data were obtained from Park JE et al. (E-MTAB-8581, https://developmentcellatlas.ncl.ac.uk ) [ 33 ], and healthy control PBMCs data were obtained from the 10X Genomics publicly available dataset (PBMC 3k, v3 chemistry, https://www.10xgenomics.com/resources/datasets ).
